title: Transfers T2: transfer payee lifecycle on the server (one per account, renamed with it, protected, listed)
description: Plan .agents/plans/2026-11-24_transfers-refactor.md, task T2. Map: transfers-map-api.md on the epic budget-e67y (points 1, 5, 8: R3, R7).
